verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page includes a "ported phone number (local or toll-free)" per user, so porting an existing number in is a documented capability of Quo itself. Nothing in the evidence describes how the port actually works. missing for 10: evidence that Quo collects the losing carrier's account details, evidence that Quo gathers the letter of authorization, evidence that Quo files and manages the port request, any porting process documentation or independent/hands-on corroboration.
